widgets_values: A dynamic high-angle first-person shot, just like a moving clip shot by a smartphone, opens on a sunlit bedroom with soft morning light outlining the wrinkles on the off-white bed sheets. First the young Asian woman with fluffy grey wolf ears, who lies on her back on the bed, arches her lower back and shifts her center of gravity to get ready to move, then slides off the edge of the mattress and walks slowly toward the camera, lifting her left arm to brush her fingertips through her dark hair before pausing beside her cheek, before tilting her chin up to expose her neck, staring directly at the camera, showing a bright smile and then gently biting her lower lip on purpose, finally stopping a short distance in front of the camera in a soft inviting posture. The camera follows her every movement with lively continuous handheld shaking, slowly pushing forward and tilting down slightly to match her shifting body. Soft rustle of the bed sheets mixes with faint bass rhythm from the next room as the background sound, then the soft magnetic sound of her breathing becomes clear. 用标准普通话说：The character says, 靠近点。in a soft, magnetic whispering voice.
